gloss: to emit; to discharge; to expel

definitions.gloss: to emit; to discharge; to expel
definitions.explanation: To release or push out substances such as gases, waste, or pollutants from a system, body, or process.

examples.english: The factory is discharging harmful substances.

notes:
A key term in environmental discussions. Most frequently encountered in the context of greenhouse gas emissions and pollution. Also used in biology for bodily excretion processes.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {排出量|はいしゅつりょう}: emission volume
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦{基準|きじゅん}→基準：00228_kijun⟧: emission standards
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦{規制|きせい}→規制：02598_kisei⟧: emission regulations
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦{削減|さくげん}→削減：11789_sakugen⟧: emission reduction
- ⟦{温室|おんしつ}{効果|こうか}ガス→温室効果ガス：24833_onshitsukoukagasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧: greenhouse gas emissions
- ⟦{排出|はいしゅつ}→排出：04632_haishutsu⟧⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧: zero emissions

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{放出|ほうしゅつ}→放出：12926_houshutsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to release, to emit — broader; can include intentional releases of energy, heat, or goods
- ⟦{排気|はいき}→排気：18980_haiki⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to exhaust (gas) — specifically for exhaust fumes from engines
- ⟦{廃棄|はいき}する→廃棄する：25537_haikisuru⟧: to discard, to dispose of — focuses on discarding waste or unwanted items
